comment: Placement constraints for bwa_layout_tool (copy next to cave_layout.json and run the tool there). Room space, meters, origin = FLOOR CENTER, +Y up, +Z forward (toward the far / main-screen wall); observer ears ~1.4 m up. From the overhead plan (imperial callouts x 25.4 mm/in). AXIS MAP: X is the LONG axis = 163-7/16 in (4.151 m); Z = 146-7/16 in (3.720 m); Y = 97-3/4 in (2.483 m) structure height. 'bounds' = speaker truss. 'nogo' = CAVE screen cube (screens + observer; speakers go BEHIND, in the truss<->screen gap: ~0.60 m/side in X, ~0.40 m/side in Z). 'obstacles' = the four 522x494x198 mm projectors, a single ROW front-to-back near X~0 (NOT the 2x2 this file guessed before). HEIGHTS ARE SURVEYED: the three REAR units have coplanar tops level with the structure top, so each spans y 2.285..2.483; the FRONT unit alone is lifted 198 mm, its BOTTOM level with the structure top, so it spans y 2.483..2.681. Because 'bounds' caps at 2.483, the front unit sits entirely at or above the placement volume and can only act through its acoustic SHADOW, never as a body exclusion; the rear three do both. PROJECTOR X/Z CENTERS ARE STILL APPROXIMATE: X~0 and the Z centers (-1.365, -0.715, -0.065, +1.565) are taken from the collaborators' ceiling keep-out envelopes (temp/SpeakerOptimization-main, config.py projector_spaces) mapped into this frame. Those envelopes are clearance volumes up to 1.8x1.6 m, not bodies, so the centers are indicative only - nudge each in the tool, or send the four measured centers for an exact drop-in. Building wall is >= 28-11/16 in (0.729 m) beyond the truss, so 'bounds' is the mount line, not the wall. 'label' is ignored by the loader.

bounds.label: speaker truss: 163-7/16 in (X) x 146-7/16 in (Z) x 97-3/4 in tall (Y); wall >=0.729 m beyond

nogo.label: CAVE screen cube 116-9/16 (X) x 115-5/16 in (Z) full height: screens + observer; speakers go behind

obstacles.label: projector 1 (522x494x198 mm) - front unit: BOTTOM level with structure top, 198 mm above the rear three; X/Z center APPROX
projector 2 (522x494x198 mm) - rear unit: TOP level with structure top (rear tops coplanar); X/Z center APPROX
projector 3 (522x494x198 mm) - rear unit: TOP level with structure top (rear tops coplanar); X/Z center APPROX
projector 4 (522x494x198 mm) - rear unit: TOP level with structure top (rear tops coplanar); X/Z center APPROX
